name: @kitora/chat
description: Kitora's messaging and collaboration kit: a framework-free chat core (timeline grouping, reactions, mentions, receipts, a pluggable realtime adapter with a fake one for demos), anchored comment threads, an activity feed and an audit log with diffs, plus compact styled React parts.

exports.name: ChatUser
exports.description: Someone who can post, react, be mentioned or appear in the audit log.

exports.name: PRESENCE
exports.description: The closed set of presence states the UI draws a dot for.

exports.name: Presence
exports.description: A user's presence state: `online`, `away`, `dnd` or `offline`.

exports.name: CHANNEL_KINDS
exports.description: The kinds of conversation; `dm` channels hide the `#` and show the other person.

exports.name: ChannelKind
exports.description: The kind of a conversation: a public `channel`, a `private` channel or a `dm`.

exports.name: Channel
exports.description: A conversation: a channel, private channel or direct message, with its members.

exports.name: Attachment
exports.description: A file or image attached to a message. `url` may be an object URL for a just-picked file.

exports.name: Reactions
exports.description: Emoji → the ids of the users who reacted with it, in reaction order.

exports.name: Message
exports.description: A chat message as the store and adapter hold it, including edit, delete and send state.

exports.name: MessageDraft
exports.description: What a composer hands the store: the store fills id, author and time.

exports.name: ReadState
exports.description: Per-user read position in one channel: the newest message they have seen.

props.name: userId
props.description: The user whose read position this is.

props.name: channelId
props.description: The channel the position is in.

props.name: messageId
props.description: The newest message the user has seen in the channel.

props.name: at
props.description: When the user read up to that message, in epoch milliseconds.

exports.name: CommentAnchor
exports.description:
Where a comment thread hangs. `element` targets a whole block by a host-chosen id (an image,
a table row, a heading); `range` targets characters inside one block, with `quote` kept so a
thread whose text was later edited away can still show what it was about.

exports.name: Comment
exports.description: One comment in a comment thread.

exports.name: CommentThread
exports.description: A thread of comments anchored to a block or a text range, open or resolved.

exports.name: ActivityEvent
exports.description: One line in an activity feed: "Ana commented on Q3 plan".

exports.name: AuditValue
exports.description: A JSON-ish value as stored in an audit record's before / after snapshot.

exports.name: AuditEntry
exports.description: One audit log record: who did what to which resource, with snapshots before and after.

exports.name: startOfDay
exports.description: Midnight of the day holding `ms`, in `timeZone` (the system's local midnight when omitted).

exports.name: buildTimeline
exports.description:
Builds the drawable timeline. Messages are sorted by time first (adapters may deliver out of
order). A group breaks on a new day, a different author, a gap over the window, or a message
that follows a deleted one, so a tombstone never hides under someone's name.

exports.name: dayLabel
exports.description: "Today", "Yesterday", a weekday within the last week, else a full date; days in `timeZone` (the system's when omitted).
exports.signature: (dayStart: number, now?: number, locale?: string, timeZone?: string) => string

exports.name: timeLabel
exports.description: Clock time for a message row ("14:05" or "2:05 PM" by locale), in `timeZone` (the system's when omitted).
exports.signature: (ms: number, locale?: string, timeZone?: string) => string

exports.name: relativeTime
exports.description: "just now", "5m", "3h", "2d", else a short date (in `timeZone`): the activity feed and comment headers use it.
exports.signature: (ms: number, now?: number, locale?: string, timeZone?: string) => string

exports.name: threadOf
exports.description: Replies to `rootId`, oldest first, and the summary the root row shows ("3 replies · last 2m").
exports.signature: (messages: readonly Message[], rootId: string) => { readonly replies: readonly Message[]; readonly participantIds: readonly string[]; readonly lastAt?: number; }

exports.name: GROUP_WINDOW_MS
exports.description: Two messages by one author further apart than this start a new group (Slack uses ~5 min).

exports.name: TimelineItem
exports.description: One row of a drawn timeline: a day divider or a group of consecutive messages by one author.

exports.name: TimelineOptions
exports.description: How {@link buildTimeline} groups messages.

exports.name: parseMarkup
exports.description:
Parses `text` into segments. A mention resolves to a user when `users` holds that handle
(case-insensitive); an unknown `@name` stays a mention without `userId`, so the UI can draw it
muted instead of linking nowhere.

exports.name: mentionedUserIds
exports.description: The user ids a message mentions (deduplicated, in order).

exports.name: mentionQueryAt
exports.description:
The `@query` being typed at `caret`, if any: what a mention autocomplete filters on. Returns
the query and where the `@` sits so the pick can replace exactly that span.
exports.signature: (text: string, caret: number) => { readonly query: string; readonly start: number; } | null

exports.name: insertMention
exports.description: Replaces the `@query` span at `start..caret` with `@handle ` and returns the new text and caret.
exports.signature: (text: string, start: number, caret: number, handle: string) => { readonly text: string; readonly caret: number; }

exports.name: toggleMark
exports.description:
Wraps `text[start..end]` in a format mark, or unwraps it when it is already wrapped. With an
empty selection it inserts a pair of marks and puts the caret between them.
exports.signature: (text: string, start: number, end: number, mark: FormatMark) => { readonly text: string; readonly start: number; readonly end: number; }

exports.name: filterMentionCandidates
exports.description: Users whose handle or name starts with (or contains) `query`, prefix matches first, at most `limit`.
exports.signature: (users: readonly ChatUser[], query: string, limit?: number) => ChatUser[]

exports.name: Segment
exports.description: One parsed piece of message markup: plain text, a styled run, a mention, a link or a line break.

exports.name: FORMAT_MARKS
exports.description: Formatting marks the composer toolbar can wrap a selection in, with their delimiter.

exports.name: FormatMark
exports.description: A formatting mark the composer can wrap a selection in: `bold`, `italic`, `strike` or `code`.

exports.name: toggleReaction
exports.description:
Adds `userId` to `emoji` or removes them if already there; an emoji nobody holds any more is
dropped so the bar never shows a "0". Insertion order of emoji is kept (first reaction first).
exports.signature: (reactions: Reactions | undefined, emoji: string, userId: string) => Reactions

exports.name: seenBy
exports.description:
The users (other than the author) whose read position in the channel is at or after `message`.
`ordered` is the channel's messages oldest first; reads pointing at unknown ids are ignored.
exports.signature: (message: Message, ordered: readonly Message[], reads: readonly ReadState[]) => string[]

exports.name: lastSeenByMessage
exports.description:
For each reader, the newest message they have seen: the list draws a reader's avatar under
that one message only (the iMessage / Messenger style), never repeated on older rows.
exports.signature: (ordered: readonly Message[], reads: readonly ReadState[], selfId: string) => ReadonlyMap<string, readonly string[]>

exports.name: unreadCount
exports.description: Unread count for `userId` in a channel: top-level messages by others after their read position.
exports.signature: (ordered: readonly Message[], reads: readonly ReadState[], userId: string) => number

exports.name: matchesCommentFilter
exports.description: Whether `thread` belongs under `filter`.

exports.name: commentsReducer
exports.description:
Applies one action. Replying to a resolved thread reopens it (the GitHub / Google Docs rule:
a new message means the conversation is live again). Deleting a thread's last comment removes
the thread. Unknown ids are a no-op that returns the same array.
exports.signature: (threads: readonly CommentThread[], action: CommentAction) => readonly CommentThread[]

exports.name: highlightPieces
exports.description:
Splits `text` at every range boundary of the given threads so overlapping comments each get
their own highlight. Ranges are clamped to the text; empty or inverted ranges are ignored.

exports.name: COMMENT_FILTERS
exports.description: Which threads a comments list shows: the closed set the rail's tabs offer.

exports.name: CommentFilter
exports.description: Which comment threads a list shows: `open`, `resolved` or `all`.

exports.name: CommentAction
exports.description: A change to a set of comment threads, applied by {@link commentsReducer}.

exports.name: HighlightPiece
exports.description: A piece of a block's text, marked with the ids of the open range threads covering it.

exports.name: diffRecords
exports.description:
Field-level changes between two snapshots, walking nested objects into dotted paths. Arrays
compare as whole values (an audit row reads "tags: [a, b] → [a, c]", not per-index noise).
A create (no `before`) lists every field as added; a delete lists every field as removed.
exports.signature: (before: AuditEntry["before"], after: AuditEntry["after"], prefix?: string) => FieldChange[]

exports.name: formatAuditValue
exports.description: One value as a short single-line string for a diff cell.

exports.name: filterAudit
exports.description: Entries matching every set facet of the filter, newest first.
exports.signature: (entries: readonly AuditEntry[], filter: AuditFilter, actorName?: (id: string) => string) => AuditEntry[]

exports.name: actionGroups
exports.description: The distinct top-level action groups (`user`, `billing`) across entries, for the filter menu.

exports.name: groupActivityByDay
exports.description: Activity events bucketed by local day, newest day first, for a feed with day headings.
exports.signature: (events: readonly ActivityEvent[], timeZone?: string) => { readonly dayStart: number; readonly events: readonly ActivityEvent[]; }[]

exports.name: CHANGE_KINDS
exports.description: The closed set of change kinds a diff row can be.

exports.name: ChangeKind
exports.description: One kind of field change in an audit diff: `added`, `removed` or `changed`.

exports.name: FieldChange
exports.description: One row of an audit diff: a field path, how it changed, and its values before and after.

exports.name: AuditFilter
exports.description: The facets an audit log is filtered on; every facet that is set must match.

exports.name: ChatEvent
exports.description: What a `ChatAdapter` reports to the store: a snapshot, then every message, typing, read, presence and connection change.

exports.name: ChatAdapter
exports.description: The transport seam a host implements over its own backend; the store sends commands through it and applies the events it emits.

exports.name: createChatStore
exports.description: Creates a chat store over an adapter: optimistic sends with retry, reactions, typing and read receipts.
exports.signature: ({ adapter, selfId, newId, now }: CreateChatStoreOptions) => ChatStore

exports.name: TYPING_TTL_MS
exports.description: A remote typing signal is dropped after this long without a refresh.

exports.name: TYPING_THROTTLE_MS
exports.description: Our own "still typing" signal is re-sent at most this often while keys keep coming.

exports.name: TypingEntry
exports.description: A remote user typing in a channel, until the time the signal expires.

props.name: selfId
props.description: The signed-in user's id.

props.name: connected
props.description: Whether the adapter reports a live connection.

props.name: users
props.description: Every known user.

props.name: channels
props.description: Every loaded channel.

props.name: messages
props.description: Every loaded message across channels, in arrival order; views sort and filter.

props.name: reads
props.description: Every user's read position, one per user and channel.

props.name: typing
props.description: Who is typing where right now; entries drop out when they expire.

exports.name: ChatStore
exports.description: The chat state behind subscribe / getState, with the commands that change it optimistically.

exports.name: CreateChatStoreOptions
exports.description: The adapter and identity {@link createChatStore} runs on.

exports.name: createFakeAdapter
exports.description: Creates an in-memory `ChatAdapter` with latency, simulated typing, replies and read receipts, for demos and tests.

exports.name: FakeAdapterOptions
exports.description: Seed data and behaviour for {@link createFakeAdapter}.

exports.name: FakeAdapter
exports.description: The in-memory adapter, plus controls a demo or test uses to simulate other people.

exports.name: FAKE_TYPING_MS
exports.description: How long a simulated person "types" before their message lands.

exports.name: formatBytes
exports.description: Human file size: 1.2 KB, 3.4 MB.

exports.name: localeFormatters
exports.description: The default formatters bound to one BCP 47 locale (the cheap way to localise every label), and optionally to a time zone.

exports.name: ChatFormatters
exports.description: Every label the chat parts format from a number; pass your own to change locale or wording in one place.

exports.name: DEFAULT_FORMATTERS
exports.description: The kit's formatters, on the runtime's default locale.

exports.name: parseHex
exports.description: `#rgb` / `#rrggbb` to 0–255 channels, or null for anything else (named colours, `oklch()`…).

exports.name: relativeLuminance
exports.description: WCAG 2 relative luminance of a hex colour (0 black … 1 white), or null when it is not hex.

exports.name: contrastRatio
exports.description: WCAG 2 contrast ratio between two hex colours (1 … 21), or null when either is not hex.

exports.name: readableInkOn
exports.description: The ink ({@link LIGHT_INK} or {@link DARK_INK}) with more contrast on `background`; light for non-hex input.

exports.name: LIGHT_INK
exports.description: The light and dark inks an avatar's initials choose between.

exports.name: DARK_INK
exports.description: The dark ink, used when it reads better than {@link LIGHT_INK} on the background.

exports.name: rangeOffsets
exports.description:
Character offsets of a DOM range relative to `root`'s text content, or null when the range is
empty or leaves `root`. Counts text nodes in document order, so it survives nested markup.
exports.signature: (root: Node, range: RangeLike) => { readonly start: number; readonly end: number; } | null

exports.name: selectionIn
exports.description:
Offsets of the window's current selection inside `root`, plus its bounding box relative to
`root` (where a "Comment" button floats), or null when nothing inside `root` is selected.
exports.signature: (root: HTMLElement) => { readonly start: number; readonly end: number; readonly x: number; readonly y: number; } | null

exports.name: RangeLike
exports.description: The fields of a DOM `Range` that `rangeOffsets` reads (a live `Range` satisfies it).

exports.name: autoGrow
exports.description: Resizes `el` to its content height, at most `maxPx`.

exports.name: resetGrow
exports.description: Collapses a grown textarea back to its natural one-row height (after a send).

exports.name: ChatProvider
exports.description: Puts a store in context for every chat part below it. The host owns the store's lifetime.

props.name: store
props.description: The store every chat part below reads and writes, from `createChatStore`.

props.name: formatters
props.description: Swap any label formatter (clock time, day heading, "5m ago", file size) for every part below.

props.name: children
props.description: The chat parts that use the store.

exports.name: useChatStore
exports.description: The store from the nearest {@link ChatProvider}; throws outside one so a missing provider is loud.

exports.name: useChatState
exports.description: The whole state; prefer the narrower hooks in large lists.

exports.name: useUserLookup
exports.description: A user lookup bound to the current state (unknown ids render as "Unknown").

exports.name: useChannelTimeline
exports.description: Top-level messages of a channel, oldest first, and the drawable timeline built from them.
exports.signature: (channelId: string) => { readonly messages: readonly Message[]; readonly timeline: readonly TimelineItem[]; }

exports.name: useThread
exports.description: The root message and replies of a thread.
exports.signature: (rootId: string | null) => { readonly root?: Message; readonly replies: readonly Message[]; }

exports.name: useTyping
exports.description: Ids of the people typing in a channel right now (or in a thread, when the host scopes channels that way).

exports.name: useChannelTitle
exports.description: A channel's display name: `name` for channels, the other person's name in a DM.

props.name: store
props.description: The store every chat part below reads and writes, from `createChatStore`.

props.name: formatters
props.description: Swap any label formatter (clock time, day heading, "5m ago", file size) for every part below.

props.name: children
props.description: The chat parts that use the store.

exports.name: useComments
exports.description: Holds comment threads in a reducer and exposes the actions the comment parts call.
exports.signature: ({ initial, users, selfId, onChange, now }: UseCommentsOptions) => CommentsApi

exports.name: CommentsProvider
exports.description: Shares a {@link useComments} result with the comment parts below it (`CommentableText`, `CommentsRail` or your own).

props.name: value
props.description: The comments state to share, from {@link useComments}.

props.name: children
props.description: The comment parts that read it.

exports.name: useCommentsContext
exports.description: The comments state from the nearest {@link CommentsProvider}; throws outside one.

exports.name: CommentsApi
exports.description: The comment threads, the active thread and the draft, with the actions the comment parts call. Returned by {@link useComments}.

exports.name: UseCommentsOptions
exports.description: The seed threads, people and change callback {@link useComments} runs on.

exports.name: ChatFormattersProvider
exports.description: Overrides some or all formatters for every chat part below; unset ones keep the parent's.

props.name: formatters
props.description: The formatters to override; the ones left out keep the parent's.

props.name: children
props.description: The chat parts that use them.

exports.name: useChatFormatters
exports.description:
The formatters in effect: the nearest provider's overrides over the defaults, which format in the locale and zone in
effect and measure "now" (when a part passes none) from the clock in effect.

exports.name: useControllable
exports.description: `[value, setValue]` that is controlled when `value` is defined and uncontrolled otherwise.
exports.signature: <T>({ value, defaultValue, onChange }: ControllableOptions<T>) => readonly [T, (next: T) => void]

exports.name: ControllableOptions
exports.description: The controlled value, the uncontrolled start value and the change callback for {@link useControllable}.

exports.name: useChatShortcuts
exports.description:
Binds `shortcuts` while mounted and `enabled`. With `scopeRef` they fire only while focus is
inside that element; without it they are page-wide (a thread panel's Escape). Handlers are
always the latest ones; the binding is redone only when the set of keys changes.
exports.signature: (part: string, shortcuts: readonly ChatShortcut[], options?: { readonly scopeRef?: RefObject<HTMLElement | null>; readonly enabled?: boolean; }) => void

exports.name: CHAT_KEYBOARD_CATEGORY
exports.description: The palette / cheatsheet category every chat command is filed under.

exports.name: ChatShortcut
exports.description: One shortcut a chat part binds: its key in the keyboard kit's notation, a title, and what it does.

exports.name: initials
exports.description: Initials for the fallback avatar: first letters of the first `max` words.

exports.name: ChatAvatar
exports.description:
Square-ish avatar (Slack style) with an optional presence dot: `@kitora/ui`'s Avatar (a broken
image falls back to initials without a flash) on the user's own colour, any pixel size, and
display's `PresenceDot` in the corner.

props.name: user
props.description: The person drawn: their image, else initials on their colour.

props.name: size
props.description: Width and height in pixels; below a small size the initials drop to one letter.

props.name: presence
props.description: Whether to draw the user's presence dot in the corner.

props.name: className
props.description: Classes for the avatar's wrapper element.

exports.name: MessageText
exports.description:
Renders the kit's markup as elements. Mentions of `selfId` get the stronger highlight Slack
uses for "you were mentioned"; unknown handles stay plain text colour.

props.name: text
props.description: The source text in the kit's light markup.

props.name: users
props.description: The people `@handle` mentions resolve against.

props.name: selfId
props.description: The signed-in user, whose mentions get the stronger highlight.

props.name: onMention
props.description: Called when a resolved mention is clicked, with its user id.

exports.name: ChatRenderersProvider
exports.description: Sets renderers for every chat part below; unset ones keep the parent's.

props.name: renderers
props.description: The renderers to set; the ones left out keep the parent's.

props.name: children
props.description: The chat parts that use them.

exports.name: useChatRenderers
exports.description: The renderers in effect from the nearest {@link ChatRenderersProvider}; empty when there is none.

exports.name: RenderedText
exports.description: Text through the host's `text` renderer when one is set, else {@link MessageText}.

props.name: text
props.description: The source text in the kit's light markup.

props.name: users
props.description: The people `@handle` mentions resolve against.

props.name: selfId
props.description: The signed-in user, whose mentions get the stronger highlight.

exports.name: ReactionBar
exports.description:
The pills under a message: emoji + count, highlighted when `selfId` reacted. Hovering a pill
names who reacted. A trailing picker adds a new reaction.

props.name: reactions
props.description: The message's reactions; nothing renders when there are none.

props.name: selfId
props.description: The signed-in user, whose own reactions are highlighted.

props.name: users
props.description: The people reactions are looked up in, for the hover names.

props.name: onToggle
props.description: Called when a pill is clicked or an emoji is picked, with the emoji to toggle.

exports.name: TypingIndicator
exports.description: "Ana is typing…", "Ana and Ben are typing…", "Several people are typing…" with animated dots.

props.name: userIds
props.description: Ids of the people typing; empty shows nothing.

props.name: users
props.description: The people the ids are looked up in, for first names.

props.name: className
props.description: Classes for the line's element.

exports.name: SeenReceipts
exports.description: Tiny stacked avatars of the people who have read up to this message.

props.name: userIds
props.description: Ids of the people who have seen the message.

props.name: users
props.description: The people the ids are looked up in, for avatars and names.

props.name: max
props.description: How many avatars to draw before a "+N" count.

exports.name: AttachmentList
exports.description: The message's files as ui `Attachment` cards: an image as its thumbnail, everything else with a file icon, the size through the chat's formatters. `onRemove` adds a × on each card's corner (composer use).

props.name: attachments
props.description: The attachments to show; nothing renders when empty.

props.name: onRemove
props.description: Called when an attachment's remove button is pressed, with its id; the button shows only when set.

exports.name: DISPLAY_PRESENCE
exports.description:
Chat presence onto display's presence set, whose `PresenceDot` draws every dot here: its "busy"
is our "do not disturb" (and it speaks it as "Do not disturb").

exports.name: TextRenderProps
exports.description: What a text renderer receives: the raw markup and who can be mentioned.

props.name: text
props.description: The source text in the kit's light markup.

props.name: users
props.description: The people `@handle` mentions resolve against.

props.name: selfId
props.description: The signed-in user, whose mentions get the stronger highlight.

exports.name: ChatRenderers
exports.description:
The renderer seam: swap how message, comment and feed text is drawn (a Markdown library, a
rich-text viewer, link previews) without touching the parts. Unset renderers use ours.

exports.name: CommentAnchor
exports.description:
Where a comment thread hangs. `element` targets a whole block by a host-chosen id (an image,
a table row, a heading); `range` targets characters inside one block, with `quote` kept so a
thread whose text was later edited away can still show what it was about.

exports.name: Comment
exports.description: One comment in a comment thread.

exports.name: CommentThread
exports.description: A thread of comments anchored to a block or a text range, open or resolved.

exports.name: ActivityEvent
exports.description: One line in an activity feed: "Ana commented on Q3 plan".

exports.name: AuditValue
exports.description: A JSON-ish value as stored in an audit record's before / after snapshot.

exports.name: AuditEntry
exports.description: One audit log record: who did what to which resource, with snapshots before and after.

exports.name: startOfDay
exports.description: Midnight of the day holding `ms`, in `timeZone` (the system's local midnight when omitted).

exports.name: buildTimeline
exports.description:
Builds the drawable timeline. Messages are sorted by time first (adapters may deliver out of
order). A group breaks on a new day, a different author, a gap over the window, or a message
that follows a deleted one, so a tombstone never hides under someone's name.

exports.name: dayLabel
exports.description: "Today", "Yesterday", a weekday within the last week, else a full date; days in `timeZone` (the system's when omitted).
exports.signature: (dayStart: number, now?: number, locale?: string, timeZone?: string) => string

exports.name: timeLabel
exports.description: Clock time for a message row ("14:05" or "2:05 PM" by locale), in `timeZone` (the system's when omitted).
exports.signature: (ms: number, locale?: string, timeZone?: string) => string

exports.name: relativeTime
exports.description: "just now", "5m", "3h", "2d", else a short date (in `timeZone`): the activity feed and comment headers use it.
exports.signature: (ms: number, now?: number, locale?: string, timeZone?: string) => string

exports.name: threadOf
exports.description: Replies to `rootId`, oldest first, and the summary the root row shows ("3 replies · last 2m").
exports.signature: (messages: readonly Message[], rootId: string) => { readonly replies: readonly Message[]; readonly participantIds: readonly string[]; readonly lastAt?: number; }

exports.name: GROUP_WINDOW_MS
exports.description: Two messages by one author further apart than this start a new group (Slack uses ~5 min).

exports.name: TimelineItem
exports.description: One row of a drawn timeline: a day divider or a group of consecutive messages by one author.

exports.name: TimelineOptions
exports.description: How {@link buildTimeline} groups messages.

exports.name: parseMarkup
exports.description:
Parses `text` into segments. A mention resolves to a user when `users` holds that handle
(case-insensitive); an unknown `@name` stays a mention without `userId`, so the UI can draw it
muted instead of linking nowhere.

exports.name: mentionedUserIds
exports.description: The user ids a message mentions (deduplicated, in order).

exports.name: mentionQueryAt
exports.description:
The `@query` being typed at `caret`, if any: what a mention autocomplete filters on. Returns
the query and where the `@` sits so the pick can replace exactly that span.
exports.signature: (text: string, caret: number) => { readonly query: string; readonly start: number; } | null

exports.name: insertMention
exports.description: Replaces the `@query` span at `start..caret` with `@handle ` and returns the new text and caret.
exports.signature: (text: string, start: number, caret: number, handle: string) => { readonly text: string; readonly caret: number; }

exports.name: toggleMark
exports.description:
Wraps `text[start..end]` in a format mark, or unwraps it when it is already wrapped. With an
empty selection it inserts a pair of marks and puts the caret between them.
exports.signature: (text: string, start: number, end: number, mark: FormatMark) => { readonly text: string; readonly start: number; readonly end: number; }

exports.name: filterMentionCandidates
exports.description: Users whose handle or name starts with (or contains) `query`, prefix matches first, at most `limit`.
exports.signature: (users: readonly ChatUser[], query: string, limit?: number) => ChatUser[]

exports.name: Segment
exports.description: One parsed piece of message markup: plain text, a styled run, a mention, a link or a line break.

exports.name: FORMAT_MARKS
exports.description: Formatting marks the composer toolbar can wrap a selection in, with their delimiter.

exports.name: FormatMark
exports.description: A formatting mark the composer can wrap a selection in: `bold`, `italic`, `strike` or `code`.

exports.name: toggleReaction
exports.description:
Adds `userId` to `emoji` or removes them if already there; an emoji nobody holds any more is
dropped so the bar never shows a "0". Insertion order of emoji is kept (first reaction first).
exports.signature: (reactions: Reactions | undefined, emoji: string, userId: string) => Reactions

exports.name: seenBy
exports.description:
The users (other than the author) whose read position in the channel is at or after `message`.
`ordered` is the channel's messages oldest first; reads pointing at unknown ids are ignored.
exports.signature: (message: Message, ordered: readonly Message[], reads: readonly ReadState[]) => string[]

exports.name: lastSeenByMessage
exports.description:
For each reader, the newest message they have seen: the list draws a reader's avatar under
that one message only (the iMessage / Messenger style), never repeated on older rows.
exports.signature: (ordered: readonly Message[], reads: readonly ReadState[], selfId: string) => ReadonlyMap<string, readonly string[]>

exports.name: unreadCount
exports.description: Unread count for `userId` in a channel: top-level messages by others after their read position.
exports.signature: (ordered: readonly Message[], reads: readonly ReadState[], userId: string) => number

exports.name: matchesCommentFilter
exports.description: Whether `thread` belongs under `filter`.

exports.name: commentsReducer
exports.description:
Applies one action. Replying to a resolved thread reopens it (the GitHub / Google Docs rule:
a new message means the conversation is live again). Deleting a thread's last comment removes
the thread. Unknown ids are a no-op that returns the same array.
exports.signature: (threads: readonly CommentThread[], action: CommentAction) => readonly CommentThread[]

exports.name: highlightPieces
exports.description:
Splits `text` at every range boundary of the given threads so overlapping comments each get
their own highlight. Ranges are clamped to the text; empty or inverted ranges are ignored.

exports.name: COMMENT_FILTERS
exports.description: Which threads a comments list shows: the closed set the rail's tabs offer.

exports.name: CommentFilter
exports.description: Which comment threads a list shows: `open`, `resolved` or `all`.

exports.name: CommentAction
exports.description: A change to a set of comment threads, applied by {@link commentsReducer}.

exports.name: HighlightPiece
exports.description: A piece of a block's text, marked with the ids of the open range threads covering it.

exports.name: diffRecords
exports.description:
Field-level changes between two snapshots, walking nested objects into dotted paths. Arrays
compare as whole values (an audit row reads "tags: [a, b] → [a, c]", not per-index noise).
A create (no `before`) lists every field as added; a delete lists every field as removed.
exports.signature: (before: AuditEntry["before"], after: AuditEntry["after"], prefix?: string) => FieldChange[]

exports.name: formatAuditValue
exports.description: One value as a short single-line string for a diff cell.

exports.name: filterAudit
exports.description: Entries matching every set facet of the filter, newest first.
exports.signature: (entries: readonly AuditEntry[], filter: AuditFilter, actorName?: (id: string) => string) => AuditEntry[]

exports.name: actionGroups
exports.description: The distinct top-level action groups (`user`, `billing`) across entries, for the filter menu.

exports.name: groupActivityByDay
exports.description: Activity events bucketed by local day, newest day first, for a feed with day headings.
exports.signature: (events: readonly ActivityEvent[], timeZone?: string) => { readonly dayStart: number; readonly events: readonly ActivityEvent[]; }[]

exports.name: CHANGE_KINDS
exports.description: The closed set of change kinds a diff row can be.

exports.name: ChangeKind
exports.description: One kind of field change in an audit diff: `added`, `removed` or `changed`.

exports.name: FieldChange
exports.description: One row of an audit diff: a field path, how it changed, and its values before and after.

exports.name: AuditFilter
exports.description: The facets an audit log is filtered on; every facet that is set must match.

exports.name: ChatEvent
exports.description: What a `ChatAdapter` reports to the store: a snapshot, then every message, typing, read, presence and connection change.

exports.name: ChatAdapter
exports.description: The transport seam a host implements over its own backend; the store sends commands through it and applies the events it emits.

exports.name: createChatStore
exports.description: Creates a chat store over an adapter: optimistic sends with retry, reactions, typing and read receipts.
exports.signature: ({ adapter, selfId, newId, now }: CreateChatStoreOptions) => ChatStore

exports.name: TYPING_TTL_MS
exports.description: A remote typing signal is dropped after this long without a refresh.

exports.name: TYPING_THROTTLE_MS
exports.description: Our own "still typing" signal is re-sent at most this often while keys keep coming.

exports.name: TypingEntry
exports.description: A remote user typing in a channel, until the time the signal expires.

exports.name: formatBytes
exports.description: Human file size: 1.2 KB, 3.4 MB.

exports.name: localeFormatters
exports.description: The default formatters bound to one BCP 47 locale (the cheap way to localise every label), and optionally to a time zone.

exports.name: ChatFormatters
exports.description: Every label the chat parts format from a number; pass your own to change locale or wording in one place.

exports.name: DEFAULT_FORMATTERS
exports.description: The kit's formatters, on the runtime's default locale.

exports.name: parseHex
exports.description: `#rgb` / `#rrggbb` to 0–255 channels, or null for anything else (named colours, `oklch()`…).

exports.name: relativeLuminance
exports.description: WCAG 2 relative luminance of a hex colour (0 black … 1 white), or null when it is not hex.

exports.name: contrastRatio
exports.description: WCAG 2 contrast ratio between two hex colours (1 … 21), or null when either is not hex.

exports.name: readableInkOn
exports.description: The ink ({@link LIGHT_INK} or {@link DARK_INK}) with more contrast on `background`; light for non-hex input.

exports.name: LIGHT_INK
exports.description: The light and dark inks an avatar's initials choose between.

exports.name: DARK_INK
exports.description: The dark ink, used when it reads better than {@link LIGHT_INK} on the background.

exports.name: rangeOffsets
exports.description:
Character offsets of a DOM range relative to `root`'s text content, or null when the range is
empty or leaves `root`. Counts text nodes in document order, so it survives nested markup.
exports.signature: (root: Node, range: RangeLike) => { readonly start: number; readonly end: number; } | null

exports.name: selectionIn

Offsets of the window's current selection inside `root`, plus its bounding box relative to
`root` (where a "Comment" button floats), or null when nothing inside `root` is selected.

exports.description: The fields of a DOM `Range` that `rangeOffsets` reads (a live `Range` satisfies it).

exports.name: autoGrow
exports.description: Resizes `el` to its content height, at most `maxPx`.

exports.name: resetGrow
exports.description: Collapses a grown textarea back to its natural one-row height (after a send).

props.name: channelId

props.name: classNames

parts.name: ChannelRoot
parts.description: One channel's frame: shares its id and inline-edit state with the parts inside, and marks it read while shown.

props.name: channelId

props.name: onOpenThread
props.description: Shows thread summaries and the reply action; defaults to opening the thread in the {@link ChatRoot}.

props.name: loading
props.description: Shown while no channel is known yet (before the first snapshot).

props.name: className

props.name: children

parts.name: ChannelHeader
parts.description: The channel bar: icon or avatar, name, topic, a connecting notice, member count, then `actions`.

props.name: actions
props.description: Extra controls at the right end of the bar.

props.name: className
props.description: Classes for the header element.

parts.name: Messages
parts.description: The channel's message list, bound to the channel's edit state and thread opener.

props.name: className
props.description: Classes for the scrolling list element.

props.name: showReceipts
props.description: Whether to show who has seen your latest message, under it.

props.name: empty
props.description: Rendered when the channel has no messages yet.

props.name: itemClassNames

parts.name: Footer
parts.description: The strip under the list that holds the typing line and the composer.

props.name: className
props.description: Classes for the strip.

props.name: children
props.description: Its content, usually a {@link ChannelTyping} and a {@link ChannelComposer}.

parts.name: Typing
parts.description: "Ana is typing…" for this channel.

props.name: className
props.description: Classes for the typing line.

parts.name: Composer
parts.description: The composer bound to this channel: sends, signals typing, ↑ edits your last message.

props.name: value
props.description: The text, when the host controls it (a saved draft, a template); pair with `onValueChange`.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: Every text change, controlled or not (sending clears it to "").

props.name: className
props.description: Classes for the composer's root element.

props.name: classNames
props.description: Per-part classes, merged after ours.

props.name: autoFocus
props.description: Whether the text box takes focus on mount, with the caret at the end.

props.name: placeholder
props.description: Shown in the empty text box.

props.name: initialText
props.description: Initial text (uncontrolled); changing it does not reset the composer (use `key` for that).

props.name: onCancel
props.description: Called when Escape or the cancel button is pressed; the cancel button shows only when set (inline edit).

props.name: allowAttachments
props.description: Whether files can be attached by the attach button, drop or paste.

props.name: showToolbar
props.description: Whether the formatting toolbar shows.

props.name: submitLabel
props.description: Label of the send button ("Send", "Save", "Comment").

props.name: compact
props.description: Whether to use the tighter padding, for inline edits and replies.

parts.name: Thread
parts.description: The side panel for one thread: the root message, a replies divider, replies and a reply composer. Escape closes.

props.name: rootId
props.description: The thread's root message; defaults to the {@link ChatRoot}'s open thread (renders nothing when none).

props.name: onClose
props.description: Defaults to closing the thread in the {@link ChatRoot}.

props.name: className
props.description: Classes for the panel's root element.

exports.name: CommentableBlock
exports.description:
A block readers can comment on as a whole (an image, a table, a paragraph). Hovering shows a
comment button in the right margin; open threads show a count badge; the active thread
outlines the block.

props.name: id
props.description: The block's id, which its element-anchored threads point at.

props.name: children
props.description: The block's content.

props.name: className
props.description: Classes for the wrapper element.

exports.name: CommentableText
exports.description:
Plain text whose selected ranges can be commented. Select text and a "Comment" button appears
above the selection; open range threads are highlighted (darker where they overlap), and
clicking a highlight activates its thread in the rail.

props.name: id
props.description: The block's id, which its range-anchored threads point at.

props.name: text
props.description: The plain text shown; range offsets count characters in it.

props.name: as
props.description: The element to render.

props.name: className
props.description: Classes for the text element.

exports.name: CommentsRail
exports.description:
The rail of thread cards: filter tabs, the new-comment card, then one card per thread. The
filter is the ui kit's `Tabs` (a real tablist with one tabpanel per filter, arrow keys included),
and the Tabs root itself is the rail's `complementary` landmark, so the rail adds no element of
its own. Place it in a host column, or in the sidebar kit's `SidebarLayout` `aside` slot next to
a nav sidebar, the way `ChatApp` places its thread panel.

props.name: className
props.description: Classes for the rail's root element.

props.name: order
props.description: Element ids in document order, so threads list top to bottom as their anchors appear.

props.name: filter
props.description: The shown tab (controlled, with `onFilterChange`); uncontrolled from `defaultFilter` when omitted.

props.name: defaultFilter
props.description: The tab shown first when uncontrolled.

props.name: onFilterChange
props.description: Called when the shown tab changes, with its filter.

exports.description:
First / previous / numbered pages with ellipses / next / last. The `@kitora/ui` pagination parts
(nav › list › items, shared ellipsis) with ui ghost buttons in the items (pages are state, not
URLs, so no anchors); `pageNumbers` keeps the zero-based window maths.

props.description: Called when a page button is pressed, with its zero-based page.

exports.name: pageNumbers
exports.description: Zero-based page numbers to show, `null` for an ellipsis: always first and last, two around the current.
